functional.question: How many sellers are there?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) FROM sellers LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many products are in the catalogue?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM products LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders are there in total?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders have been delivered?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders were cancelled?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many distinct product categories are there?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) FROM products LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories have the most products, using the Portuguese category names?
functional.sql: SELECT T2.product_category_name FROM order_items AS T1 INNER JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id GROUP BY T2.product_category_name ORDER BY COUNT(T1.product_id) DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the average product weight in grams?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(product_weight_g) AS average_product_weight FROM products LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 states have the most sellers?
functional.sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders were placed in 2017?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the highest price paid for a single item?
functional.sql: SELECT MAX(price) AS highest_price_paid FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many order items are there?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers generated the most revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'invoiced', 'processing', 'created', 'approved') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: Which 5 product categories generated the most revenue?
What is the average freight value per item?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(freight_value) AS average_freight_value FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers sell the most distinct products?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS product_count FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders are there in each status?
functional.sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE NOT order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY order_status LIMIT 10

functional.question: What was the total revenue in 2017?
functional.sql: SELECT SUM(order_items.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 products generated the most revenue?
What is the average number of items per order?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(order_item_id) AS average_items_per_order FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 seller states generated the most revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_state, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders contain more than one item?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(order_item_id) > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers received the most orders?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the total freight cost across all order items?
functional.sql: SELECT SUM(freight_value) AS total_freight_cost FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories have the highest average item price?
functional.sql: SELECT T2.product_category_name FROM order_items AS T1 JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id GROUP BY T2.product_category_name ORDER BY AVG(T1.price) DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders were placed in each year?
functional.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE NOT order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which month of 2017 had the most orders?
functional.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY month ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

functional.question: What is the average item price?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS average_item_price FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers have the highest average item price?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, AVG(oi.price) AS average_item_price FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY average_item_price DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What was the total revenue in each year?
functional.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, SUM(price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE NOT orders.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many sellers have sold products in more than 3 different categories?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS seller_count FROM order_items JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id JOIN category_translation ON products.product_category_name = category_translation.product_category_name GROUP BY seller_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT category_translation.product_category_name) > 3 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories have the highest freight cost as a share of revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT pt.product_category_name_english, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue, SUM(oi.freight_value) AS total_freight_cost, (SUM(oi.freight_value) / SUM(oi.price)) * 100 AS freight_cost_percentage FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation AS pt ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY pt.product_category_name_english ORDER BY freight_cost_percentage DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: Which 5 product categories are sold by the most distinct sellers?
functional.sql: SELECT T2.product_category_name FROM order_items AS T1 JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id JOIN sellers AS T3 ON T1.seller_id = T3.seller_id GROUP BY T2.product_category_name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T3.seller_id) DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What is the average revenue per seller?
How many orders were delivered later than the estimated delivery date?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers generated the most revenue in 2018?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What share of orders were cancelled?
functional.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 sellers have the highest average freight cost per item?
functional.sql: SELECT s.seller_id, AVG(oi.freight_value) AS avg_freight_cost FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY avg_freight_cost DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many sellers generated more revenue than the average seller?
Which 5 product categories have the heaviest average product weight?
functional.sql: SELECT T2.product_category_name FROM order_items AS T1 JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id GROUP BY T2.product_category_name ORDER BY AVG(T2.product_weight_g) DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders have not been delivered yet?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM orders WHERE NOT order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the average delivery time in days?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(CAST((JULIANDAY(order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(order_purchase_timestamp)) AS INTEGER)) AS average_delivery_time FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the average time in hours between an order being placed and approved?
What is the average revenue per order?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS average_revenue_per_order FROM order_items LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which single order had the highest total value?
functional.sql: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.price) AS total_value FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 1

functional.question: Which 5 customer states generated the most revenue?
functional.sql: SELECT customers.customer_state, SUM(order_items.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id WHERE orders.order_status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'invoiced', 'processing', 'created', 'approved') GROUP BY customers.customer_state ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: Which 5 customer states have the highest average order value?
functional.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(oi.price) AS average_order_value FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY average_order_value DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: Which 5 customer cities placed the most orders?
functional.sql: SELECT customers.customer_city, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id GROUP BY customers.customer_city ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many customers have placed more than one order?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS num_customers FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id GROUP BY customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What share of customers are repeat buyers?
Which payment types are used most often?
functional.sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_count DESC LIMIT 1

functional.question: What is the average number of payment instalments?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(payment_installments) FROM order_payments LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the total value paid by credit card?
functional.sql: SELECT SUM(payment_value) AS total_credit_card_payments FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 product categories generated the most revenue, named in English?
functional.sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation AS ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

functional.question: How many orders were paid in more than one instalment?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(payment_installments) > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the total item revenue from orders paid by credit card?
functional.sql: SELECT SUM(order_items.price) AS total_item_revenue FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id JOIN order_payments ON orders.order_id = order_payments.order_id WHERE order_payments.payment_type = 'credit_card' LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What percentage of orders were paid by credit card?
functional.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS credit_card_percentage FROM order_payments LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders were paid using more than one payment type?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT payment_type) > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: How many orders were paid with a voucher combined with another payment type?
functional.sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'voucher' AND payment_sequential > 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: What is the median delivery time in days?
functional.sql: SELECT AVG(CAST((JULIANDAY(order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(order_purchase_timestamp)) AS INTEGER)) AS median_delivery_time FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY CAST((JULIANDAY(order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(order_purchase_timestamp)) AS INTEGER) HAVING COUNT(*) % 2 = 1 LIMIT 1000

functional.question: Which 5 customer states have the slowest average delivery time?
functional.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(JULIANDAY(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_delivery_time FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_delivery_time ASC LIMIT 5

functional.question: What share of order items were bought from a seller in the same state as the customer?
Which 5 customer states rely most on sellers from other states?
functional.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE s.seller_state <> c.customer_state GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 5
